description: Asteroid Shooter — rotate, thrust and blast splitting asteroids on canvas. 3 lives, rising levels.

faqs.a: ←/→ rotate, ↑ thrust, Space fires. On touch screens use the on-screen buttons.
faqs.q: How do I control the ship?

faqs.a: Big asteroids split into two medium ones, mediums split into two small ones. Big = 20, medium = 50, small = 100 points.
faqs.q: What happens when I shoot an asteroid?

faqs.a: Clear every asteroid to advance a level — each level adds more, faster asteroids.

howto: Blast asteroids; big ones split into smaller ones.
Avoid collisions — you have 3 lives with brief shields after each hit.
Clear the field to level up.
title: Asteroid Shooter
